<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import csv
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Paths
    gtfs_dir = Path("inputs/gtfs")
    out_dir = Path("outputs")
    out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

    # Read stops
    stops_path = gtfs_dir / "stops.txt"
    df_stops = pd.read_csv(
        stops_path,
        dtype={
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_name": "string",
            "stop_lat": "float64",
            "stop_lon": "float64",
        },
        # GTFS uses default comma separator
    )

    # Count and remove invalid coordinates
    valid_lat = df_stops["stop_lat"].between(-90, 90, inclusive="both")
    valid_lon = df_stops["stop_lon"].between(-180, 180, inclusive="both")
    mask_valid = valid_lat & valid_lon
    invalid_coordinates_removed = int(~mask_valid).sum()
    df_stops = df_stops[mask_valid].copy()

    # Count and remove duplicate full rows (keep first)
    original_len = len(df_stops)
    df_stops = df_stops.drop_duplicates(keep="first")
    duplicate_stops_removed = original_len - len(df_stops)

    # Replace missing stop names
    # Treat empty strings or whitespace-only as missing
    missing_mask = df_stops["stop_name"].isna() | (df_stops["stop_name"].str.strip() == "")
    missing_stop_names_filled = int(missing_mask).sum()
    df_stops.loc[missing_mask, "stop_name"] = "Unknown"

    n_clean_stops = len(df_stops)

    # Read stop_times
    stop_times_path = gtfs_dir / "stop_times.txt"
    df_stop_times = pd.read_csv(
        stop_times_path,
        dtype={
            "trip_id": "int64",
            "arrival_time": "string",
            "departure_time": "string",
            "stop_id": "int64",
            "stop_sequence": "int64",
        },
    )

    # Keep rows whose stop_id is present in cleaned stops
    df_stop_times_clean = df_stop_times[df_stop_times["stop_id"].isin(df_stops["stop_id"])]
    n_clean_stop_times = len(df_stop_times_clean)

    # Write CSV outputs, quoting per RFC4180
    outfile_stops = out_dir / "t05_clean_stops.csv"
    df_stops.to_csv(outfile_stops, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONNUMERIC)

    outfile_stop_times = out_dir / "t05_clean_stop_times.csv"
    df_stop_times_clean.to_csv(outfile_stop_times, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONNUMERIC)

    # Write cleaning report JSON
    report = {
        "invalid_coordinates_removed": invalid_coordinates_removed,
        "duplicate_stops_removed": duplicate_stops_removed,
        "missing_stop_names_filled": missing_stop_names_filled,
        "n_clean_stops": n_clean_stops,
        "n_clean_stop_times": n_clean_stop_times,
    }
    with open(out_dir / "t05_gtfs_cleaning_report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
